create_evaluator_for_task: create an Evaluator instance for a task like s2ef, is2rs, or is2re with default metrics
eval_predictions_against_targets: run evaluator.eval to compute metrics comparing prediction and target dictionaries of torch tensors
compute_mae_metric: compute the mean absolute error between predicted and target values using the mae function
compute_cosine_similarity: compute cosine similarity between predicted and target force vectors using the cosine_similarity function
compute_energy_forces_within_threshold: compute the fraction of systems where energy error is below 0.02 and max force error is below 0.03
